description: The Haven at Brouwershaven is the old basin in the centre, with house fronts along the quay. The quay walls were renewed with basalt-pattern facing and were open again by April 2026, so the new face is shown. A low bridge crosses the lock. It is overcast, about 12.5°C, with wind near 7.9 km/h and cloud cover about 100%. No boat name and no restaurant name are readable. The church is not the subject.
